briefing: Markets jumped sharply, with the NASDAQ up 6.8% and the S&P 500 up 4.9%. A move this big is unusual, so the figures may cover more than one trading day. We hold all 7 existing positions and let their automatic profit targets and stop-losses work. We put our $646 of spare cash to work, NVDA first and then INTC, because both show every signal we look for, including heavy trading volume.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: 'Risk-on' describes a day when investors feel confident and move money into growth assets like tech stocks instead of safe options like cash or bonds. You can tell it is happening when prices rise across many stocks at once, especially fast-growing ones. Risk-on days are good for adding positions, but very sharp jumps can reverse, so stop-losses still matter.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險偏好升溫」(Risk-On)是指投資者信心增強，將資金從現金、債券等避險資產轉投科技股等增長型資產。當大市普遍上升，尤其是高增長股份領漲時，就是典型的Risk-On格局。這類日子適合增持倉位，但急升過後亦可能出現回吐，因此止蝕機制仍不可或缺。

market_education.summary_en: US stocks rallied broadly today: the NASDAQ rose 6.8% and the S&P 500 rose 4.9%, led by semiconductor and AI-infrastructure names such as NVDA, MU, DELL and MRVL, many of which broke above their 20-day averages. Heavy trading volume in leaders like NVDA, INTC and TSLA suggests large investors were buying, not just a thin bounce. No news headlines came with today's data, so we cannot name a specific cause; the explanation is based only on price and volume.
market_education.summary_zh: 美股今日全面強勢反彈，納指急升6.8%，標普500指數亦揚4.9%，半導體及AI基建股領漲，NVDA、MU、DELL、MRVL等多隻個股紛紛升穿20日均線。NVDA、INTC及TSLA等龍頭股成交量明顯放大，顯示有大型機構資金入市，並非單純的弱勢反彈。由於今日數據未附相關新聞標題，暫未能確定具體觸發因素，以上分析僅依據價格及成交量。

trades.reasoning: NVDA shows all four signals the strategy asks for (MACD crossover, RSI 64.5 below 70, price well above its 20-day average, and a volume surge), so this looks like real buying from big investors on a strong up day.
INTC also has all four signals with a moderate RSI of 59, which makes it a good second pick if cash is left after NVDA; it is medium conviction because the portfolio already holds a lot of tech.
